description: Research open source robotics datasets more generally (e.g. Open X-Embodiment, DROID, LeRobot hub / SO-101 datasets, and newer ones). For each: size, license, embodiment, modalities, and fit for training our world action model on our gripper. Write findings into the repo's docs so any agent can use them.

results.identified_issue: Research-only turn, no code. Licenses were read from HF cardData via the API on 2026-10-19; HF tags are uploader-typed. DROID's license is inconsistent: the official page names none, the LeRobot ports say Apache-2.0, and secondary sources say CC BY 4.0. FastUMI's license was not found. GenRobot's size is self-reported, and its card gives both 36.9 TB and 95 TB. Community stats come from a throwaway random sample (seed 0) of 150 of the 1,220 repos in allenai/MolmoAct2-SO100_101-Dataset/repo_list.json, reading meta/info.json; 53 were unreadable (deleted or gated). The 'wrist cam' count keys off camera names, and LeRobot defaults ('laptop'/'phone') hide placement, so it's a lower bound. ABC-130K figures come from a search summary of the gated XDOF card plus the lerobot port's info.json. The FLUX license note follows robot_model_scouting.md, which says robotics use is non-commercial; world_action_model.md says otherwise and is older.
results.summary: Wrote plans/robot_datasets.md: 20+ open robot datasets rated for size, license, embodiment, cameras and fit for our SO-101 gripper.
results.detailed_description:
New doc: plans/robot_datasets.md, the robot-data companion to the egocentric survey, linked from the README. It covers LeRobot community SO-100/101 data, the MolmoAct2 SO-101 manifest, DROID, Open X-Embodiment, Bridge, RoboMIND, ABC-130K, AgiBot World, Galaxea, PrimeBot, GenRobot's handheld-gripper set, FastUMI and a few sim sets. Licenses come from each Hugging Face card, read through the API today.

Short list: (1) LeRobot community SO-101 data is the only external data in our exact joint space. That's about 250 h curated, plus Ai2's list of 1,220 repos with re-written instructions. (2) DROID is the only big robot set with a third-person stereo pair like ours, so it's good for the video half. (3) ABC-130K has 3,590 h under Apache-2.0 on a 6-DoF YAM. GenRobot's handheld gripper with 1 mm tactile arrays is the closest match to our handheld-demo idea, but it's CC BY-SA.

I sampled 150 community SO-101 repos. Most have about 10 episodes. 27% have no license, and the Apache tag is usually just LeRobot's default. Every contributor's calibration differs, so the data needs per-repo normalisation. Next step if you want it: build that filter and see how many usable hours survive.

summary: Survey open source robotics datasets such as Open X-Embodiment, DROID, and LeRobot hub SO-101 sets, recording size, license, embodiment, and modalities for each. Document findings in the repo docs, rating each dataset's fit for training our world action model on our gripper.
